title: Our five senses
examples: What do I use to see the colors?
How does my body know if something is hot?
Can I smell flowers with my ears?

explain.say: Today you will learn about your five senses. They are sight, hearing, smell, taste and touch.
Sight lets you see colours and shapes. You see with your eyes.
Hearing lets you hear sounds. You hear with your ears.
Smell lets you smell things, like flowers. You smell with your nose.
Taste lets you taste food, like a sour lemon. You taste with your tongue.
You use your senses together. You can see and hear a bird singing. You feel things with your skin too.

faq.q: Which sense do I use to know if something is soft?
faq.a: You use your sense of touch. Your skin feels if something is soft.
asks: How do I know if it is fuzzy?

faq.q: Can my eyes help me smell things?
faq.a: No. Your eyes are for seeing. You smell with your nose.

faq.q: Do I need all five senses to play?
faq.a: No. Your senses work together to help you play and learn. People who cannot see or hear still play and learn, using their other senses.
asks: Can I play without my ears?

faq.q: Is taste the same as smell?
faq.a: No. You taste with your tongue and smell with your nose. Smell helps food taste stronger.

faq.q: What part of my body helps me hear sounds?
faq.a: Your ears help you hear sounds.
asks: What do I use to listen?

facts: Eyes help us see colours and shapes.
Ears help us hear loud and soft sounds.
Noses help us smell all kinds of smells.
Tongues help us taste sweet, sour, and salty.
Skin helps us feel things like hot and cold.

quiz.say: You hold an ice cube. Which sense tells you it is cold?
quiz.why: Your skin feels hot and cold. That is touch.

wrong.0: Sight shows you the ice, and touch feels how cold it is.
wrong.1: Ice makes no sound to tell you it is cold.

quiz.say: You sniff a flower. Which sense are you using?
quiz.why: You smell with your nose when you sniff.

wrong.1: Sight is for seeing, with your eyes.
wrong.2: Taste is for food, with your tongue.

quiz.say: You listen to music. Which sense helps you?
quiz.why: You hear music with your ears.

wrong.0: Touch is for feeling things with your skin.
wrong.2: Smell is for sniffing, with your nose.
